entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  Bollinger position = 118% of band -> -100 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  distance to EMA20 = +9.28% -> -56 (weight 1.8) - Price 2,743.24 vs EMA20 2,510.25
  RSI 1h = 75.6 -> -40 (weight 2.0) - Overbought - entries here chase the move
  RSI daily = 70.8 -> -40 (weight 1.2) - Overbought - entries here chase the move
  RSI divergence (1d) = hidden bullish -> +35 (weight 1.3) - strength 100/100
  resistance proximity = 11.4% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance

  weighted sum / total weight (8.5) = -32.7 -> UNFAVORABLE
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
